title: Activity entry (one line of a ticket's run log)
description: profiles/<slug>/tickets/<id>/activity.jsonl (or its gzip copy activity.jsonl.gz), and profiles/<slug>/chats/<id>.activity.jsonl: one compact JSON object per line, appended by Store.appendActivity. Type ActivityEntry in src/server/types.ts. This is the persisted per-line record of a ticket's runs; there is no separate chat message file in the data folder (the conversation itself is Claude Code's session transcript under ~/.claude/projects, found by the ticket's sessionId). event is either the board's marker {type: 'ckanban_run', kind}, written first for each run, or one event of claude --output-format stream-json exactly as Claude Code printed it (stream_event deltas are not stored). Saved keys are masked. Unknown fields must be kept.

run.description: The ticket's run number. Quick chats always write 1.

type.description: ckanban_run, or a Claude Code stream-json type: system, assistant, user, result, control_request, control_response, ...

kind.description: Only on ckanban_run: what the run was.
